{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash --login

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./mirge_Y0.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from LSF:
#   -nnodes 1  -> -N 1
#   -W 720     -> -t 720m
#   jsrun -g 1 -> -g 1
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -g 1 -t 720m --wrap "bash --login $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: LSF -G uiuc not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  # NOTE: LSF -q pbatch not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the pbatch queue.

  # NOTE: LSF -J mirge_Y0 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance unaffected.

  # NOTE: LSF -o/-e used %J expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  module load gcc/7.3.1
  module load spectrum-mpi

  conda deactivate || true
  conda activate mirgeDriver.Y1nozzle

  export PYOPENCL_CTX="port:tesla"
  jsrun_cmd="jsrun -g 1 -a 1 -n 1"
  export XDG_CACHE_HOME="/tmp/$USER/xdg-scratch"

  # Keep jsrun since this is intended for an IBM/Summit-like environment.
  flux run -n 1 -g 1 $jsrun_cmd js_task_info
  flux run -n 1 -g 1 $jsrun_cmd python -u -m mpi4py ./nozzle.py
fi
"
}
